release_notes:
## Toolbar behavior corrected

- The bottom editor toolbar is no longer selectable, movable, scalable, rotatable, or saved as a pause-menu block.
- The eye button now collapses only the toolbar while Edit Mode remains active.
- Ordinary pause-menu blocks remain selectable, movable, scalable, hideable, and editable while the toolbar is collapsed.
- A compact eye button at the lower-right edge restores the toolbar without clearing the current block selection.
- Entering Edit Mode again always shows the toolbar in its normal position.
